title: SS27 Boys' Refined Sport
summary: Sport made smarter for boys: mesh and piqué polos, track sets in clean colour, UV tees and swim shorts that move from pitch to pool.
research_period: Pitti Bimbo 103, Florence, 24-25 June 2026; Playtime Paris, 28-30 June 2026; analysis July to November 2026
markets: Premium and mid-market childrenswear, Europe-led fairs, global retail

sections.heading: The story
sections.body: Playtime Paris showed sport "through a more refined, creative lens" <sup>[1]</sup>. Pitti Bimbo's pool theme <sup>[2]</sup> and the move to UV-protective, quick-dry pieces <sup>[3]</sup> make performance a summer basic. Teeter Totter's UPF50+ swim and sportswear <sup>[4]</sup> show the product. Most SS27 kidswear sources describe collections across ages and genders. The evidence below is the fair record; the shapes, products and sizes are Forecut's application of it to boyswear, roughly ages 4 to 14.

sections.heading: Colours
sections.body: Navy, red and white, with aqua and grass green. Red is the season's newness <sup>[1]</sup>.

sections.heading: Silhouettes
sections.body:
- Piqué and mesh polos.
- Track jacket and shorts set.
- Swim shorts with a matching UV tee.
- Pull-on shorts with a flat drawcord-free waistband.

sections.heading: Fabrics
sections.body:
- Micro-mesh and piqué <sup>[5]</sup>.
- UPF-rated swim and jersey.
- Recycled polyester for track pieces <sup>[3]</sup>.

sections.heading: Trims and details
sections.body:
- Contrast piping and side stripes.
- Rubberised badges instead of metal.
- Flat, covered elastic waists.

products:
- Polos, track sets, UV tees, swim shorts, caps, sneakers.
- Customer: boys who choose their own clothes; parents buying for camp and holiday.
design_implications:
- No drawstrings at the waist of swim shorts for younger sizes; use elastic and a flat tie only where permitted for the age.
- Test UPF claims to EN 13758 or AS/NZS 4399.
- Safety: no drawstrings or long cords at the hood, neck or waist, in line with EN 14682; test the attachment strength of buttons, snaps and decorations, and keep small detachable parts off baby and toddler pieces.
commercial_implications: - Track sets and polos are reorder lines; buy depth in navy and red.
